tex_content.html:
If a focusing triangle has base $\xi $ of length at most one and bounds $B$, then \[ L(\xi )\le \int _\xi k_{\mathrm{geod}}\, ds+\Area (B). \]
Proof

↗ claim:focusing-triangle-angle-curvature-bound ↗ claim:focusing-triangle-vertex-geodesic \sketch Gauss–Bonnet on each radial subwedge gives $\int _{\lambda (t)}k_{\mathrm{geod}}ds\le t_\xi +a(B)$. Combine this with Claim 6, $\max h\le 1/2+\delta '$, and $l(0)=0$.

□

Corollary
[Bound on total base length of a disjoint collection of focusing triangles]
